events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored a season-high 43 points and made a go-ahead 3-pointer with 32.6 seconds remaining as the Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the Cleveland Cavaliers 117-112 on Monday night in the first of a two-game set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 43 points, hits go-ahead 3-pointer in Thunder's 117-112 win over Cavs

headlines.description: — Zion Williamson scored 25 points including nine in overtime, Jeremiah Fears hit two free throws with 7.3 seconds left, and the New Orleans Pelicans handed the Memphis Grizzlies their first loss of the season, 135-134 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Williamson's 25 points, free throws by Fears, give Pelicans 135-134 win over Grizzlies in overtime
